title: BUILT CoLAB takes part in Congrega 2024

content:
BUILT CoLAB will be present at Congrega 2024 – the 1st Ibero-American Congress on Asset Engineering and Management and the 2nd Portuguese Congress on Asset Engineering and Management.

The international event will take place in Lisbon between 3 and 5 July at the FIL Meeting Centre and will focus on Sustainable and Digital Innovation in Engineering Asset Management, bringing together representatives from industry, academia and research, government and civil society.

Ana Catarina Rocha, Digital Transition Specialist at BUILT CoLAB, will be present and will present two scientific papers submitted and accepted for the Congress, both on sustainability and digitalisation.

The presentations will take place in the following sessions:

4th July, session 11-12:30

Article “Parametric modelling of anomalies in railway tunnels”, co-authored by Inês Caetano, Débora Pinto, João Silva, Yessica Barbosa, Hugo Patrício, Miguel Azenha, Luís Sanhudo and João Poças Martins.

4th July, session 15-16:30

Article “Ex-ante evaluation of the production of bituminous mixtures considering three alternative production scenarios”, co-authored by Vanessa Tavares, Marco Pedroso, João Afonso and João Poças Martins.

We would like to remind you that BUILT CoLAB is one of the organisations institutionally supporting this event and all the information is available at https://congrega.eu/ .
